Description: Disposable passive Malcolm/Zeek capture sensor in an existing subnet; separate stack avoids changes to the running demo stack. Mirroring is opt-in after bootstrap verification.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: One source ENI -> VXLAN -> private sensor ENI -> bounded PCAP -> Zeek / optional Malcolm
must: Do not change existing routes, hosts, security groups or XSIAM models.

SensorSubnetId.Description: Existing subnet in source VPC and source AZ, with working egress and SSM.

SourceEniId.Description: One supported EC2 source ENI, not the sensor ENI.

UbuntuAmiId.Description: Canonical Ubuntu Server 24.04 amd64 EBS AMI in this Region; verify owner 099720109477.

must: Do not add administrator or source-host mutation permissions.

must: Only source ENI primary IPv4 may send UDP 4789.
Do not attach this group to existing resources.

Package repositories, container pulls and SSM

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Explicit target ENI avoids unsupported primary-ENI instance attributes
must: Keep subnet in the source VPC and AZ; preserve source/destination checks.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Disposable 8-vCPU 32-GiB sensor supports a small Malcolm evaluation without burst credits
must: No public IP or key pair; IMDSv2 mandatory.
Root volume and captures are deleted on teardown; export only approved evidence first.
CloudFormation completion does not assert bootstrap or Malcolm readiness.

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/mirror-lab /var/lib/mirror-lab/capture
exec > >(tee -a /var/log/mirror-lab-bootstrap.log) 2>&1
trap 'touch /var/lib/mirror-lab/BOOTSTRAP_FAILED' ERR
cat > /etc/systemd/system/mirror-lab-stop.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Stop disposable mirror lab sensor
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemctl poweroff
UNIT
cat > /etc/systemd/system/mirror-lab-stop.timer <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Bound sensor running time after each boot
[Timer]
OnBootSec=${AutoShutdownMinutes}min
Unit=mirror-lab-stop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now mirror-lab-stop.timer
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tcpdump docker.io docker-compose-v2 curl unzip python3 python3-dialog python3-dotenv python3-pip python3-ruamel.yaml
systemctl enable --now docker
snap start amazon-ssm-agent
# No key pair, passwords, tokens, or Malcolm authentication are generated here.
docker pull zeek/zeek@sha256:71c1d6b61cdcc25d306c091d32b3da15583485c0c9dfc45cdff48b088cdfdc92
cat > /usr/local/sbin/mirror-capture-test <<'CAPTURE'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
iface=$(ip -o route get $(echo ${SourceIpv4Cidr} | cut -d/ -f1) | awk '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) if ($i=="dev") {print $(i+1); exit}}')
test -n "$iface"
# Scope is outer VXLAN only, one 60-second run, four ~100 MB ring files.
# Use a new directory per run; old runs must be removed before repeated testing.
run=$(mktemp -d /var/lib/mirror-lab/capture/test.XXXXXX)
echo "Capture directory: $run; interface: $iface"
set +e
timeout --signal=INT 60 tcpdump -i "$iface" -nn -s 0 -U -C 100 -W 4 -Z root -w "$run/mirror.pcap" 'udp dst port 4789'
rc=$?
set -e
if [ "$rc" != 0 ] && [ "$rc" != 124 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
chmod 0600 "$run"/*
echo "Capture finished. Inspect packet and dropped counts above."
CAPTURE
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/mirror-capture-test
# Stack CREATE_COMPLETE only establishes provisioning; this marker is a separate readiness check.
touch /var/lib/mirror-lab/BOOTSTRAP_READY
